edits.before: Late Xerath wins fights from the next postal code: stun the entry, barrage the objective, and never be seen.
edits.after: Two items in, Sanguine Pool dodges your snipes and his sustain outlasts the poke — fight with your team, from max range.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shocking Orb for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Vladimir W Sanguine Pool: 28s at rank 1, 16s maxed — bait the untargetable dodge before you spend a kill window; step up only in its downtime. - Budget your 13s E for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: His only dodge outside the 28s Pool window is walking — Q the last-hit, then drop W's centre on his sidestep for the stronger slow.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Overextended into fog is where a gank meets your zero mobility — his pool escapes the counter-gank while your death funds his scaling.
